messages:
maria: Heads-up — QA + accessibility flagged the console key routing table. Screen readers read the model column then say 'unlabeled' for the quota column, and the org/project badge contrast is low. Can we fix without a full redesign? cc @ashok @kat
ashok: Saw the ticket. Short-term: add aria-labels to the quota cell and a text prefix 'Quota:' (visually hidden) for screen readers. Long-term: maybe an explicit 'Attribution' column. Question: are we ok changing DOM order? that could affect telemetry selectors.
kat: Prefer not to change DOM order if we can avoid it. a11y best practice is logical DOM order, but we rely on data-attributes for telemetry click handlers. Suggest adding a visually-hidden label (aria) instead of reordering.
jules: Product also wants per-key routing policy (region / cost-tier) surfaced inline. That might crowd rows — could show in a flyout / row expand instead.
maria: Good call. For telemetry, adding aria-text shouldn't break selectors if we keep data-key-id on the same cell. @infra-bot can you schedule a canary for the console CSS tweaks?
infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for console-canary at 2026-06-15T18:00Z :rocket: (will include CSS + aria label patch)
ashok: One more backend note: the query to pull quota attribution currently adds a join that increases p95 by ~12ms. If we add a column we should cache attribution in the ui-serving layer. I'll prototype adding attr_hint to /keys:list to avoid the join on every page load.
kat: please make the API change opt-in (e.g. ?include_attr_hint=true) so existing consumers aren't impacted. also add a unit test for the cached path.
jules: :thumbsup: Also can we add a tiny tooltip explaining what attr_hint is (so support doesn't get confused)?
maria: Plan recap: 1) aria labels + visually-hidden prefix today, 2) opt-in API field attr_hint on /keys:list, 3) canary CSS deploy, 4) follow-up column if metrics stable. I'll open a UX ticket and link PR. Thanks all :heart:
